sanskrit: evaṃ bruvāṇaṃ janakaḥ pratyuvāca kṛtāñjaliḥ śrotum arhasi bhadraṃ te kulaṃ naḥ kīrtitaṃ param
english: To him who had spoken thus, Janaka replied with joined palms: 'May it be well with you — you deserve to hear our lineage recited in full.'

sanskrit: pradāne hi muniśreṣṭha kulaṃ niravaśeṣataḥ vaktavyaṃ kulajātena tan nibodha mahāmune
english: For at the time of giving in marriage, O foremost of sages, one born of a noble line must declare that lineage without remainder. Hear it, O great sage.

sanskrit: rājābhūt triṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ svena karmaṇā nimiḥ paramadharmātmā sarvasattvavatāṃ varaḥ
english: There was a king named Nimi, renowned through all three worlds by his own deeds, supremely righteous in soul, the foremost among all beings of steadfast character.

sanskrit: tasya putro mithir nāma janako mithi putrakaḥ prathamo janako nāma janakād apy udāvasuḥ
english: His son was named Mithi; Mithi's son was Janaka — the first of that name. From that Janaka was born Udāvasu.

sanskrit: udāvasos tu dharmātmā jāto vai nandivardhanaḥ nandivardhana putras tu suketur nāma nāmataḥ
english: From Udāvasu was born Nandivardhana, righteous in soul; and Nandivardhana's son was named Suketu.

sanskrit: suketor api dharmātmā devarāto mahābalaḥ devarātasya rājarṣer bṛhadratha iti śrutaḥ
english: From Suketu too was born Devarāta, righteous in soul and of great might. From that royal sage Devarāta was known Bṛhadratha.

sanskrit: bṛhadrathasya śūro 'bhūn mahāvīraḥ pratāpavān mahāvīrasya dhṛtimān sudhṛtiḥ satyavikramaḥ
english: Bṛhadratha's son was the hero Mahāvīra, of great valor and blazing energy. From Mahāvīra was born Sudhṛti, steady of resolve and true in valor.

sanskrit: sudhṛter api dharmātmā dhṛṣṭaketuḥ sudhārmikaḥ dhṛṣṭaketos tu rājarṣer haryaśva iti viśrutaḥ
english: From Sudhṛti too was born Dhṛṣṭaketu, righteous in soul and of excellent virtue. From that royal sage Dhṛṣṭaketu became known Haryaśva.

sanskrit: haryaśvasya maruḥ putro maroḥ putraḥ pratīndhakaḥ pratīndhakasya dharmātmā rājā kīrtirathaḥ sutaḥ
english: Haryaśva's son was Maru; Maru's son was Pratīndhaka; and the son of Pratīndhaka, righteous in soul, was King Kīrtiratha.

sanskrit: putraḥ kīrtirathasyāpi devamīḍha iti smṛtaḥ devamīḍhasya vibudho vibudhasya mahīdhrakaḥ
english: The son of Kīrtiratha too is remembered as Devamīḍha; from Devamīḍha came Vibudha, and from Vibudha came Mahīdhraka.

sanskrit: mahīdhrakasuto rājā kīrtirāto mahābalaḥ kīrtirātasya rājarṣer mahāromā vyajāyata
english: Mahīdhraka's son was King Kīrtirāta, of great might. From that royal sage Kīrtirāta was born Mahāromā.

sanskrit: mahāroṃṇas tu dharmātmā svarṇaromā vyajāyata svarṇaroṃṇas tu rājarṣer hrasvaromā vyajāyata
english: From Mahāromā, righteous in soul, was born Svarṇaromā; and from that royal sage Svarṇaromā was born Hrasvaromā.

sanskrit: tasya putradvayaṃ jajñe dharmajñasya mahātmanaḥ jyeṣṭho 'ham anujo bhrātā mama vīraḥ kuśadhvajaḥ
english: To him, that great-souled knower of righteousness, two sons were born: I am the elder, and the younger, my heroic brother, is Kuśadhvaja.

sanskrit: māṃ tu jyeṣṭhaṃ pitā rājye so 'bhiṣicya narādhipaḥ kuśadhvajaṃ samāveśya bhāraṃ mayi vanaṃ gataḥ
english: My father, lord of men, anointed me, the elder, to the kingdom; entrusting the burden to me with Kuśadhvaja in my care, he went to the forest.

sanskrit: vṛddhe pitari svaryāte dharmeṇa dhuram āvaham bhrātaraṃ devasaṃkāśaṃ snehāt paśyan kuśadhvajam
english: When my aged father departed to heaven, I carried the yoke of duty righteously, watching over my brother Kuśadhvaja — radiant as a god — with affection.

sanskrit: kasya cit tv atha kālasya sāṃkāśyād agamat purāt sudhanvā vīryavān rājā mithilām avarodhakaḥ
english: Then after some time, the mighty King Sudhanvā came from the city of Sāṃkāśya and laid siege to Mithilā.

sanskrit: sa ca me preṣayām āsa śaivaṃ dhanur anuttamam sītā kanyā ca padmākṣī mahyaṃ vai dīyatām iti
english: And he sent word to me: 'Give me the incomparable bow of Śiva, and the lotus-eyed maiden Sītā — let them be given to me.'

sanskrit: tasyāpradānād brahmarṣe yuddham āsīn mayā saha sa hato 'bhimukho rājā sudhanvā tu mayā raṇe
english: Because I did not give them, O brahmarṣi, battle ensued between us, and King Sudhanvā, pressing forward, was slain by me in combat.

sanskrit: nihatya taṃ muniśreṣṭha sudhanvānaṃ narādhipam sāṃkāśye bhrātaraṃ śūram abhyaṣiñcaṃ kuśadhvajam
english: Having slain that lord of men, Sudhanvā, O foremost of sages, I installed my heroic brother Kuśadhvaja at Sāṃkāśya.

sanskrit: kanīyān eṣa me bhrātā ahaṃ jyeṣṭho mahāmune dadāmi paramaprīto vadhvau te munipuṃgava
english: This one is my younger brother and I am the elder, O great sage. With the greatest joy I give you two daughters-in-law, O foremost of sages.

sanskrit: sītāṃ rāmāya bhadraṃ te ūrmilāṃ lakṣmaṇāya ca vīryaśulkāṃ mama sutāṃ sītāṃ surasutopamām
english: Sītā to Rāma — may it be well with you — and Ūrmilā to Lakṣmaṇa; my daughter Sītā, whose bride-price is valor and who is like the daughter of the gods.

sanskrit: dvitīyām ūrmilāṃ caiva trir vadāmi na saṃśayaḥ dadāmi paramaprīto vadhvau te raghunandana
english: And Ūrmilā as the second — I say this three times, without doubt. With the greatest delight I give these two daughters-in-law to you, O joy of the Raghu line.

sanskrit: rāmalakṣmaṇayor rājan godānaṃ kārayasva ha pitṛkāryaṃ ca bhadraṃ te tato vaivāhikaṃ kuru
english: O king, have the gift of cows performed for Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa, and the ancestral rites as well — may it be auspicious for you — and then conduct the wedding.

sanskrit: maghā hy adya mahābāho tṛtīye divase prabho phalgunyām uttare rājaṃs tasmin vaivāhikaṃ kuru rāmalakṣmaṇayor arthe dānaṃ kāryaṃ sukhodayam
english: For today is the Maghā asterism, O mighty-armed one, and on the third day hence, O lord, is Uttara Phalgunī, O king — on that day perform the wedding. For the sake of Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa let the auspicious gift-giving be performed.

sanskrit: tam uktavantaṃ vaidehaṃ viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ uvāca vacanaṃ vīraṃ vasiṣṭhasahito nṛpam
english: To Vaideha who had thus spoken, the great sage Viśvāmitra, together with Vasiṣṭha, addressed these brave words to the king.

sanskrit: acintyāny aprameyāni kulāni narapuṃgava ikṣvākūṇāṃ videhānāṃ naiṣāṃ tulyo 'sti kaś cana
english: The lineages of the Ikṣvākus and the Videhas are beyond reckoning and beyond measure, O bull among men — there is no one equal to them.

sanskrit: sadṛśo dharmasaṃbandhaḥ sadṛśo rūpasaṃpadā rāmalakṣmaṇayor rājan sītā cormilayā saha
english: The union is well-matched in righteousness, well-matched in the wealth of beauty — O king, Sītā and Ūrmilā with Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa.

sanskrit: vaktavyaṃ ca naraśreṣṭha śrūyatāṃ vacanaṃ mama
english: And there is something more to be said, O foremost of men — hear my words.

sanskrit: bhrātā yavīyān dharmajña eṣa rājā kuśadhvajaḥ asya dharmātmano rājan rūpeṇāpratimaṃ bhuvi sutādvayaṃ naraśreṣṭha patnyarthaṃ varayāmahe
english: This younger brother of yours, O knower of righteousness, is King Kuśadhvaja. His two daughters, O king, whose beauty on earth is unrivalled — we seek them, O foremost of men, as wives.

sanskrit: bharatasya kumārasya śatrughnasya ca dhīmataḥ varayema sute rājaṃs tayor arthe mahātmanoḥ
english: For the young prince Bharata and the wise Śatrughna, O king, we seek those two daughters for those great-souled ones.

sanskrit: putrā daśarathasyeme rūpayauvanaśālinaḥ lokapālopamāḥ sarve devatulyaparākramāḥ
english: These sons of Daśaratha are all endowed with beauty and youth, comparable to the guardians of the world, equal to the gods in valor.

sanskrit: ubhayor api rājendra saṃbandhenānubadhyatām ikṣvākukulam avyagraṃ bhavataḥ puṇyakarmaṇaḥ
english: By this alliance with both, O lord of kings, let the Ikṣvāku line be unshakably bound to you of meritorious deeds.

sanskrit: viśvāmitravacaḥ śrutvā vasiṣṭhasya mate tadā janakaḥ prāñjalir vākyam uvāca munipuṃgavau
english: Having heard the words of Viśvāmitra and concurring with the view of Vasiṣṭha, Janaka spoke with joined palms to those two foremost of sages.

sanskrit: sadṛśaṃ kulasaṃbandhaṃ yad ājñāpayathaḥ svayam evaṃ bhavatu bhadraṃ vaḥ kuśadhvajasute ime patnyau bhajetāṃ sahitau śatrughnabharatāv ubhau
english: 'The alliance of lineages you yourselves have ordained is well-matched — so let it be; may it be auspicious for you. Let these two daughters of Kuśadhvaja become wives; let Śatrughna and Bharata, together, receive them both.'

sanskrit: ekāhnā rājaputrīṇāṃ catasṛṇāṃ mahāmune pāṇīn gṛhṇantu catvāro rājaputrā mahābalāḥ
english: On one and the same day, O great sage, let the four mighty princes grasp the hands of the four princesses.

sanskrit: uttare divase brahman phalgunībhyāṃ manīṣiṇaḥ vaivāhikaṃ praśaṃsanti bhago yatra prajāpatiḥ
english: On the following day, O brahman, under the Phalgunī asterisms, the wise commend the wedding rite — there where Bhaga the Prajāpati presides.

sanskrit: evam uktvā vacaḥ saumyaṃ pratyutthāya kṛtāñjaliḥ ubhau munivarau rājā janako vākyam abravīt
english: Having spoken these gentle words, King Janaka rose and, with joined palms, addressed both those foremost of sages.

sanskrit: paro dharmaḥ kṛto mahyaṃ śiṣyo 'smi bhavatoḥ sadā imāny āsanamukhyāni āsetāṃ munipuṃgavau
english: 'The highest dharma has been conferred upon me; I am ever your pupil. Let the foremost of sages be seated on these principal seats.'

sanskrit: yathā daśarathasyeyaṃ tathāyodhyā purī mama prabhutve nāsit saṃdeho yathārhaṃ kartum arhathaḥ
english: 'As this city is Daśaratha's, so too is mine. There is no doubt about your lordship over it — you are fit to act here as befits you.'

sanskrit: tathā bruvati vaidehe janake raghunandanaḥ rājā daśaratho hṛṣṭaḥ pratyuvāca mahīpatim
english: While Vaideha Janaka spoke thus, King Daśaratha, joy of the Raghu line, joyfully replied to that lord of the earth.

sanskrit: yuvām asaṃkhyeya guṇau bhrātarau mithileśvarau ṛṣayo rājasaṃghāś ca bhavadbhyām abhipūjitāḥ
english: 'You two brothers, lords of Mithilā, are of immeasurable virtues. Sages and assemblies of kings alike are honored by you.'

sanskrit: svasti prāpnuhi bhadraṃ te gamiṣyāmi svam ālayam śrāddhakarmāṇi sarvāṇi vidhāsya iti cābravīt
english: 'May you prosper; may it be well with you. I shall go to my own dwelling, having performed all the śrāddha rites.' So he also said.

sanskrit: tam āpṛṣṭvā narapatiṃ rājā daśarathas tadā munīndrau tau puraskṛtya jagāmāśu mahāyaśāḥ
english: Having taken leave of that lord of men, the illustrious King Daśaratha then departed quickly, placing those two lords of sages at the fore.

sanskrit: sa gatvā nilayaṃ rājā śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ prabhāte kālyam utthāya cakre godānam uttamam
english: Having gone to his quarters, the king performed the śrāddha according to rule, and rising early at dawn he performed the noble gift of cows.

sanskrit: gavāṃ śatasahasrāṇi brāhmaṇebhyo narādhipaḥ ekaikaśo dadau rājā putrān uddhiśya dharmataḥ
english: The king, lord of men, gave hundreds of thousands of cows to the brāhmaṇas, each lot dedicated individually to each of his sons, in accordance with dharma.

sanskrit: suvarṇaśṛṅgāḥ saṃpannāḥ savatsāḥ kāṃsyadohanāḥ gavāṃ śatasahasrāṇi catvāri puruṣarṣabhaḥ
english: Four hundred thousand cows with gilded horns, in fine condition, each with her calf, with bronze-fitted milking vessels — so gave that bull among men.

sanskrit: vittam anyac ca subahu dvijebhyo raghunandanaḥ dadau godānam uddiśya putrāṇāṃ putravatsalaḥ
english: And much other wealth besides, the Raghu-joy gave to the twice-born. Dedicated as the gift-of-cows for his sons, he who cherished his sons gave lavishly.

sanskrit: sa sutaiḥ kṛtagodānair vṛtaś ca nṛpatis tadā lokapālair ivābhāti vṛtaḥ saumyaḥ prajāpatiḥ
english: And that king, surrounded by his sons for whom the gift-of-cows had been performed, shone at that moment like the gentle Prajāpati surrounded by the guardians of the world.

sanskrit: yasmiṃs tu divase rājā cakre godānam uttamam tasmiṃs tu divase śūro yudhājit samupeyivān
english: On that very day on which the king performed the noble gift of cows, the hero Yudhājit arrived.

sanskrit: putraḥ kekayarājasya sākṣād bharatamātulaḥ dṛṣṭvā pṛṣṭvā ca kuśalaṃ rājānam idam abravīt
english: The son of the Kekaya king, the actual maternal uncle of Bharata — having seen and enquired after the welfare of the king, he spoke thus.

sanskrit: kekayādhipatī rājā snehāt kuśalam abravīt yeṣāṃ kuśalakāmo 'si teṣāṃ saṃpraty anāmayam
english: 'The lord king of Kekaya sends his loving regards and asks after your welfare. Those for whose well-being you are concerned — may they be free of illness now.'

sanskrit: svasrīyaṃ mama rājendra draṣṭukāmo mahīpate tadartham upayāto 'ham ayodhyāṃ raghunandana
english: 'O lord of kings, O lord of the earth, desiring to see my nephew, O joy of the Raghu line, I came to Ayodhyā for that purpose.'

sanskrit: śrutvā tv aham ayodhyāyāṃ vivāhārthaṃ tavātmajān mithilām upayātās tu tvayā saha mahīpate tvarayābhyupayāto 'haṃ draṣṭukāmaḥ svasuḥ sutam
english: 'Having heard, however, that your sons had set out for Mithilā for the wedding — together with you, O lord of the earth — I came hastening here, eager to see my sister's son.'

sanskrit: atha rājā daśarathaḥ priyātithim upasthima dṛṣṭvā paramasatkāraiḥ pūjārhaṃ samapūjayat
english: Then King Daśaratha, having received that welcome guest, honored him who was worthy of honor with the highest marks of respect.

sanskrit: tatas tām uṣito rātriṃ saha putrair mahātmabhiḥ ṛṣīṃs tadā puraskṛtya yajñavāṭam upāgamat
english: Then, having spent that night together with his great-souled sons, he went to the sacrificial enclosure, placing the seers at the fore.

sanskrit: yukte muhūrte vijaye sarvābharaṇabhūṣitaiḥ bhrātṛbhiḥ sahito rāmaḥ kṛtakautukamaṅgalaḥ vasiṣṭhaṃ purataḥ kṛtvā maharṣīn aparān api
english: At the auspicious hour of Vijaya, Rāma, adorned with all ornaments and invested with the sacred marriage threads, accompanied by his brothers and placing Vasiṣṭha and other great seers at the fore —

sanskrit: vasiṣṭho bhagavān etya vaideham idam abravīt
english: — the venerable Vasiṣṭha came forward and spoke thus to Vaideha:

sanskrit: rājā daśaratho rājan kṛtakautukamaṅgalaiḥ putrair naravaraśreṣṭha dātāram abhikāṅkṣate
english: 'King Daśaratha, O king, with his sons invested with the auspicious marriage threads, O foremost of the best of men, awaits the giver of the brides.'

sanskrit: dātṛpratigrahītṛbhyāṃ sarvārthāḥ prabhavanti hi svadharmaṃ pratipadyasva kṛtvā vaivāhyam uttamam
english: 'For all purposes are accomplished through the giver and the receiver together. Fulfil your own dharma by performing the supreme wedding rite.'

sanskrit: ity uktaḥ paramodāro vasiṣṭhena mahātmanā pratyuvāca mahātejā vākyaṃ paramadharmavit
english: Thus addressed by the great-souled Vasiṣṭha, the supremely generous one, blazing with great splendor, knower of the highest dharma, replied with these words:

sanskrit: kaḥ sthitaḥ pratihāro me kasyājñā saṃpratīkṣyate svagṛhe ko vicāro 'sti yathā rājyam idaṃ tava
english: 'What doorkeeper stands blocking me? Whose command am I waiting upon? What deliberation is there in one's own home? This kingdom is yours even as it is mine.'

sanskrit: kṛtakautukasarvasvā vedimūlam upāgatāḥ mama kanyā muniśreṣṭha dīptā vahner ivārciṣaḥ
english: 'My daughters, O foremost of sages, have come to the foot of the altar, adorned with all the wedding ornaments, radiant as the flames of fire.'

sanskrit: sajjo 'haṃ tvatpratīkṣo 'smi vedyām asyāṃ pratiṣṭhitaḥ avighnaṃ kurutāṃ rājā kimarthaṃ hi vilambyate
english: 'I am ready and wait for you, standing established at this altar. Let the king proceed without obstruction — why indeed is there delay?'

sanskrit: tadvākyaṃ janakenoktaṃ śrutvā daśarathas tadā praveśayām āsa sutān sarvān ṛṣigaṇān api
english: Hearing those words spoken by Janaka, Daśaratha then led in all his sons and also the company of seers.

sanskrit: abravīj janako rājā kausalyānandavardhanam iyaṃ sītā mama sutā sahadharmacarī tava pratīccha caināṃ bhadraṃ te pāṇiṃ gṛhṇīṣva pāṇinā
english: King Janaka spoke to him who increases the joy of Kausalyā: 'This Sītā, my daughter, shall be your partner in dharma. Receive her — may it be auspicious for you — grasp her hand with your hand.'

sanskrit: lakṣmaṇāgaccha bhadraṃ te ūrmilām udyatāṃ mayā pratīccha pāṇiṃ gṛhṇīṣva mā bhūt kālasya paryayaḥ
english: 'Lakṣmaṇa, come — may it be auspicious for you. Receive Ūrmilā, whom I have raised up for you; grasp her hand. Let not the auspicious moment pass.'

sanskrit: tam evam uktvā janako bharataṃ cābhyabhāṣata gṛhāṇa pāṇiṃ māṇḍavyāḥ pāṇinā raghunandana
english: Having spoken thus, Janaka also addressed Bharata: 'Take the hand of Māṇḍavī with your hand, O joy of the Raghu line.'

sanskrit: śatrughnaṃ cāpi dharmātmā abravīj janakeśvaraḥ śrutakīrtyā mahābāho pāṇiṃ gṛhṇīṣva pāṇinā
english: And the righteous lord Janakeśvara also said to Śatrughna: 'O mighty-armed one, grasp the hand of Śrutakīrti with your hand.'

sanskrit: sarve bhavantaḥ saṃyāś ca sarve sucaritavratāḥ patnībhiḥ santu kākutsthā mā bhūt kālasya paryayaḥ
english: 'You are all disciplined and all of excellent vows. Let the Kākutsthas be together with their wives — let not the auspicious moment pass.'

sanskrit: janakasya vacaḥ śrutvā pāṇīn pāṇibhir aspṛśan catvāras te catasṛṇāṃ vasiṣṭhasya mate sthitāḥ
english: Hearing the words of Janaka, the four of them touched the four pairs of hands, standing in accordance with the direction of Vasiṣṭha.

sanskrit: agniṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā vediṃ rājānam eva ca ṛṣīṃś caiva mahātmānaḥ saha bhāryā raghūttamāḥ yathoktena tathā cakrur vivāhaṃ vidhipūrvakam
english: Circumambulating the fire, the altar, and the king himself, and also the great-souled seers, the foremost of the Raghus, accompanied by their wives, performed the wedding in accordance with the prescribed rites, exactly as had been ordained.

sanskrit: puṣpavṛṣṭir mahaty āsīd antarikṣāt subhāsvarā divyadundubhinirghoṣair gītavāditranisvanaiḥ
english: A great shower of flowers fell from the sky, brilliant and auspicious, accompanied by the resounding of divine kettledrums and the sounds of song and instrumental music.

sanskrit: nanṛtuś cāpsaraḥsaṃghā gandharvāś ca jaguḥ kalam vivāhe raghumukhyānāṃ tad adbhutam ivābhavat
english: Hosts of apsarases danced and gandharvas sang melodiously at the wedding of the foremost of the Raghus — it was as though a wonder had come to pass.

sanskrit: īdṛśe vartamāne tu tūryodghuṣṭaninādite trir agniṃ te parikramya ūhur bhāryā mahaujasaḥ
english: While all this was taking place, with the uproar of instruments resounding, those ones of great might circumambulated the fire three times, carrying their wives.

sanskrit: athopakāryāṃ jagmus te sadārā raghunandanaḥ rājāpy anuyayau paśyan sarṣisaṃghaḥ sabāndhavaḥ
english: Then those joys of the Raghu line, together with their wives, went to the bridal chamber; and the king too followed, beholding all, with the company of seers and kinsmen.
